description.value: Victoria Bike Rentals operates from a distinctive yellow container at Ogden Point Cruise Ship Terminal (Pier B), offering a fleet of modern 21-speed hybrid city bikes complete with helmet, lock, front and rear lights, and a route map. The company also runs fully guided electric pedicab tours covering Beacon Hill Gardens, Fisherman's Wharf, the Inner Harbour, Old Town, and Chinatown, with guides carrying 10–20 years of local experience. Kids' bikes, child seats, and baby trailers are available on request, making it a family-friendly option for cycling Victoria's notably flat and bike-friendly streets.

address.value: Ogden Point Cruise Ship Terminal, Pier B, Victoria, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and provides rich detail. The business explicitly states 'Do you have electric bikes? No. We offer 21-speed hybrid pedal bikes only.' confirming no e-bikes. Bike rentals are confirmed via the /bike-rental/ subpage with a full fleet of hybrid city bikes including helmet, lock, lights, and map. Guided pedicab tours are confirmed on the /pedi-cab-tour/ subpage. No evidence of mechanical repair services, pump access, or other workshop amenities — this is a rental-and-tour operation based at a cruise ship terminal, not a bike shop.
concerns: OSM name is 'Victoria Bike Rentals' but the website consistently uses 'Victoria Bike Rentals and Tours' or 'Victoria Bike Rentals & Pedicab Tours' — OSM name may be incomplete.
No phone or address in OSM tags; phone (+1 250-661-9692) and address (Ogden Point Cruise Ship Terminal, Pier B) sourced from website only.

Business model is primarily oriented toward cruise ship passengers (rental duration tied to port stay); utility for multi-day touring cyclists is limited, though walk-up all-day rentals are available.
No evidence of any mechanical repair, pump, or workshop services — does not meet required criteria for a full Bike Services listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active bike rental business in Victoria with a decade-plus track record, positive TripAdvisor ratings, and verifiable contact details; useful for touring cyclists who need a rental in the city even though the primary clientele are cruise ship day-visitors.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business explicitly states no electric bikes are offered ('Do you have electric bikes? No. We offer 21-speed hybrid pedal bikes only.'). Contact email vicbikerentals@gmail.com is listed on the website but not in OSM.

Bike rentals.detail: Fleet of modern 21-speed hybrid city bikes available for all-day rental; includes helmet, lock, front/rear lights, and map. Kids' bikes, child seats, and baby trailers available on request. Walk-ups accepted

Guided rides.detail: Fully guided electric pedicab tours (2–2.5 hours, max 12 people) covering Beacon Hill Gardens, Fisherman's Wharf, Inner Harbour, Old Town, and Chinatown. Pickup from cruise terminal or Empress Hotel downtown
